verdictMeaning: The existing material is not yet a complete, authenticated-with-stated-limits, anonymous six-character evaluator packet. This is an evidence-readiness verdict, not rejection of text as a medium, not an E9 quality judgment, and not a requirement to screenshot every line.
blindComparison: No blind comparison was performed. This reviewer was explicitly told the reference is Disco Elysium and read its named database. Source recognition is certain. The review assesses an acquisition method and cannot supply an A/B preference, a blind pass, or any element completion claim.
phase: pre-refutation; coordinator will assign a separate reviewer and preserve this original

methodDecision.answer: Conditionally feasible as authored-dialogue source material, explicitly unexecuted. The current evidence does not justify declaring the eventual packet complete or the E9 result measured.
methodDecision.reason: The governing CLAUDE.md expressly permits actual works as text. BM-CHR-01 assesses six people's ways of reasoning through independent criticism without implementation source as judge input; it does not prescribe one screenshot per utterance. Accurately preserved spoken prose, choices, alternatives and conversational context can expose a written argument and an articulated purpose without observing each line rendered. Requiring every DB line to be captured on screen would add an acquisition requirement not present in those rules.
retainedRequirements: E9 remains a six-person character element; isolated memorable quotations or six actor names are not evidence of six adequate character profiles.

E9's declared comparison method includes actual dialogue and play records. BM-CHR-02 retains its development bible versus actual-play cross-check. A reference text dossier cannot replace the candidate's actual-play evidence or turn a DB path into a play record.

BM-CHR-01 still excludes implementation source from evaluator input. A private DB extraction/condition audit is preparation; a judge sees actual authored text and choices with necessary context, not scripts, variable identifiers, author descriptions or an engineer's inferred character motives.

Every outcome or character change attributed to an executed state still needs execution evidence. This method does not measure delivery, timing, animation, voice, encounter frequency, natural play, check success, or actual runtime reachability.

Source identity must remain undisclosed to the judge, recognition must be recorded honestly, and anonymization must preserve the writing being assessed. No criterion, reference, threshold or completion status changes.
methodDecision.authenticityPosition: Whole-DB official certification and screenshot coverage for every sentence are not blanket prerequisites established by the governing rules. The pinned third-party extraction plus limited displayed-text corroboration can support a qualified, explicitly inferential source attribution. It cannot support the stronger claim that every row is authenticated published-game output. Any acceptance of that inference must state the source/version uncertainty and handle contradictory or disconnected records; perfect-certainty language is unjustified.

riskAssessment.sourceMisrepresentation: No evidence of fabrication was found. The supported label is a pinned third-party dialogue extraction with local displayed-text corroboration. Calling it an official full transcript, an actual playthrough, a verified successful check or a fully authenticated published-game corpus would exceed the evidence. A repository hash authenticates an object identity, not its authorship or runtime use.
riskAssessment.scope: Six candidate actors are present, but locators and counts do not demonstrate six complete comparable conflict profiles. E8 facts, routes and foreshadowing criteria must not be imported as new E9 acquisition gates; E9's own context and actual-play requirements remain.
riskAssessment.conditionMisreading: A blank leaf condition is not an unconditional line. Preserve hidden parents, choices, checks, modifiers, alternatives, scripts and external boundaries privately. In a reader, label unresolved state gates and branches honestly; do not invent satisfied states, infer roll success or treat opposite conditions as a continuous conversation.
riskAssessment.textIdentity: Retain exact original speaker attribution, prose, choices, emphasis markers, punctuation and alternate text; track every field to DB coordinates and hashes. Private structural metadata cannot substitute for these words. Formatting transformations need an audited reversible mapping and semantic verification, not automatic whitespace/word normalization. Current UTF-8 roundtrip is limited evidence, not a final renderer certification.
riskAssessment.anonymization: Source names in acquisition files and author metadata belong only in the coordinator manifest. Removing those outer labels can preserve text quality. Replacing names within dialogue, rewriting culturally specific references, suppressing skill voices, merging branches or paraphrasing reasoning changes the character writing. Keeping faithful text may still reveal its source; no successful blind evaluator is established. A prose-recognizing judge's result must remain invalid rather than being fixed through rewriting or outcome shopping.
riskAssessment.asymmetricEvidence: Giving one side all its alternate arguments and the other one short played path can skew apparent depth and conceal counterexamples. Use the same presentation policy and sufficiently comparable conflict scope, with all alternatives retained in the selected units and omissions declared. Equal word counts or artificial truncation are not a substitute for adequate matched scope. The candidate side was not inspected here.

minimalViableMethod.action: Freeze the reference DB and existing corroboration in a coordinator-only manifest. Name the exact public commit, byte hash, internal date and source limitations. Label the material as an unexecuted authored-dialogue extraction, not a played transcript.
minimalViableMethod.verifiableTarget: Every selected text field has a DB coordinate and exact UTF-8 hash; zero fields are described as executed solely because they exist in the DB. No claim that the eight-plus-three excerpt authenticates the whole DB.

minimalViableMethod.action: Use the six existing actor candidates as starting locators, then choose coherent conflict units that actually permit judgments about reasoning and purposes. Keep the initiating challenge, interlocutor replies, offered choices, relevant prior context and change/consequence context. Preserve all branches, checks and alternate prose inside those units; maintain explicit cross-unit boundaries and an appendix for entry-unconfirmed rows.
minimalViableMethod.verifiableTarget: A six-person coverage manifest distinguishes source availability from adequate assessed coverage. Every outgoing boundary and every omitted context unit is accounted for. No concatenation across mutually exclusive alternatives; no inference that all conditions are satisfiable. A coherent unit, not an arbitrary quotation quota, determines extent.

minimalViableMethod.action: Build two equivalent readers from actual authored text, keeping raw source and scripts out of judge input. Present alternative exchanges as alternatives rather than player events. Keep exact wording and speaker relationships; disclose state uncertainty in the same neutral format on both sides. If a condition cannot be explained without inventing context, show the bounded variant as conditional and leave the affected conclusion unresolved.
minimalViableMethod.verifiableTarget: Lossless text-field roundtrip, complete selected-unit alternate/choice accounting and independently checked branch labels. No invented connective prose presented as game text; no misleading statement that all authored options were simultaneously offered. No source-specific acquisition labels in judge materials.

minimalViableMethod.action: Keep candidate actual-play evidence and the BM-CHR-02 bible cross-check separate from the literary comparison. Corroborate or qualify source identity at the selected-unit level using available evidence and record inference, rather than adding a universal per-line screenshot rule. Additional display evidence is targeted when a concrete text or state discrepancy matters.
minimalViableMethod.verifiableTarget: Each runtime-dependent conclusion has actual play support or remains unmeasured. Each source-authenticity conclusion identifies which facts are observed and which are inferred. No relaxation of the six-person threshold or implementation-source exclusion.

minimalViableMethod.action: Have a separate reviewer refute the extraction/context claims before a later source-unaware comparison. Record recognition before soliciting preference. Preserve raw and refuted records, all failed blind attempts and the exact material-to-build association.
minimalViableMethod.verifiableTarget: Separate refutation record and a later comparison record that either establishes non-recognition and adequate scope, or honestly remains not measured. This method review itself supplies neither.

findings.problem: Current provenance establishes a frozen third-party DB and a narrow displayed excerpt, while four candidate text nodes have no route from the known graph entrypoints; it does not establish that every selected row is published-game output.
findings.why: A corpus can preserve authored alternatives and still contain context-unconfirmed material. Treating all rows as displayed dialogue would give the character comparison stronger evidence than was acquired.
findings.fix: Create a manifest with 100% of selected fields traced to exact DB coordinates/hashes, explicit observed-versus-inferred source status, and all 4 graph-entry-unconfirmed rows labeled separately. Verify with python disco-e9-method-r2/context-probe.py; require 0 unsupported execution or whole-DB official-authentication claims. This does not require a screenshot for every line.
findings.hypothesis: The unconnected rows could be orphaned content or externally dispatched entries. Neither explanation was established; no row should be declared cut or played on this evidence alone.

findings.shot: disco-material-r1/review.json DM-CAST-03; source-probes.json units and samples
findings.problem: The original husband's three graphs supply only two independent living NPC subjects, and the additional four actor locators have not yet been turned into six complete contextual reader units.
findings.why: Having six names in the database does not demonstrate enough dialogue and counterposition to judge six ways of reasoning or six independent purposes.
findings.fix: Produce a 6-of-6 source-unit coverage manifest and reader inventory tied to the exact authored exchanges, including every selected-unit alternate and unresolved context boundary; keep the E9 status unmeasured until that material supports the locked six-person assessment. Inspect counts with python disco-e9-method-r2/source-probe.py, and assess adequacy separately from counts.
findings.hypothesis: The ten existing locator units may be sufficient starting material. Their size and candidate content do not prove that a fair, complete six-person comparative packet has been assembled.

findings.shot: Pinned actual speaker/prose samples; governing CLAUDE.md blind comparison and quality-preserving anonymity rules
findings.problem: All current acquisition material is source-identifying, and no quality-preserving anonymous reader or non-recognizing evaluator has been tested for the proposed six-character text comparison.
findings.why: The work's names and distinctive reasoning may identify the source even after outer labels are removed. Editing those qualities to hide identity changes the material under assessment.
findings.fix: Keep 0 source/acquisition labels in the judge packet and 0 untracked prose rewrites; retain a private exact-text hash map and record the assigned judge's recognition before preference. A recognized source invalidates that blind attempt and remains preserved rather than being rewritten or repeatedly re-run for a favorable outcome.
findings.hypothesis: A new judge may or may not recognize faithful text. Feasibility of anonymity is unmeasured, not permanently impossible and not guaranteed by removing filenames.
